sources.origin: re-drawn from the site's CSS logo (violet rounded square + 'P', 'PilotDesk' Montserrat 800) — the site has no logo image file

logo.notes: The site's logo is CSS, not an image: re-drawn at 2-4x size as transparent PNGs. Violet 'P' mark works on light and dark; use the -ondark lockup on #101828. 'MOCKPILOT' is the name of the mock-test module inside the app (indigo wordmark) — use it for in-product scenes, PilotDesk for the brand sign-off.

voice.tagline: Grow your institute. Run it smarter.
say: Marketing, mock tests, attendance, fees and parent updates in one place
avoid: Hero-card numbers (184 leads, 92% attendance, ₹2.4L, 1,248 tests) — illustrative dashboard figures, not real claims
Customer counts, rankings or 'India's best' style superlatives (none on site)

facts.claim: PilotDesk brings marketing, mock tests, attendance, fees and parent updates into one platform for coaching institutes
Services include Google & Meta ads, creatives, lead management, daily mock tests, PYQs, assignments, attendance, timetable, parents portal, fees and online payments
Free consultation via call or WhatsApp on +91 89201 52023

offerings.name: MockPilot — Tests
offerings.detail: Test library for students and staff: filter by access, exam, category and test; each card shows questions, marks, duration; Start test or Create assignment. Access modes: Public, Private (institute students), Assigned (only via a live assignment).

offerings.name: MockPilot — Manage tests
offerings.detail: Edit or soft-delete tests (active / deleted views); test builder with title, exam, category, description, duration, access mode; question types plain text, equation, image with text, live preview, marks; every question is saved to the question bank. Question bank with revisions and archive.

offerings.name: MockPilot — AI generator
offerings.detail: Build a mock test with AI from an exam + topic (topic is checked first) or from uploaded material (up to 5 files: PDF, Word export, text, images; 20 MB each) so questions are grounded in your notes. Steps: Topic check → Configure → Generate → Review → Publish. Review every question: AI-inferred answers flagged, edit, insert equations, reorder, approve/reject, preview the learner test, then publish with visibility.

offerings.name: MockPilot — Submissions
offerings.detail: Review attempts from institute members; filter by test, exam, category, student and date range; sort submissions.

usage: Growth Green is a fill colour (badges, ticks, success chips) with dark ink on it; never green text on the light background (2.9:1).
Primary violet and secondary indigo are close in hue: use violet for brand moments, indigo only inside MockPilot app recreations.
notes: The website has no photos — scenes should use designed UI recreations of the app (no pasted screenshots).
